content.text: Now let me stress-test at the documented input bounds for performance and memory:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource, os
# 128 streams x 65536-byte bodies = 8 MiB DATA total; 256 events + headers
events = []
N = 128
for i in range(N):
    sid = i * 4
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [
        [':method', 'POST'], [':scheme', 'https'], [':authority', 'demo.test'],
        [':path', '/big%d' % i], ['content-length', '65536'], ['x-pad', 'v'*100]]})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'data', 'hex': ('5142'*32768)})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'})
scen = {'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'rack'}, 'events': events}
blob = json.dumps(scen).encode()
print('serialized input MiB', len(blob)/2**20)
t0 = time.time()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/bridge.py'], input=blob,
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt = time.time()-t0
print('rc', proc.returncode, 'wall %.2fs' % dt, 'stdout MiB', len(proc.stdout)/2**20,
      'stderr', proc.stderr[:300])
out = json.loads(proc.stdout)
fwd = [s for s in out['streams'] if s['status']=='forwarded']
print('forwarded', len(fwd), 'total length', sum(s['length'] for s in fwd))
raw = bytes.fromhex(out['origins']['rack'])
print('pipeline MiB', len(raw)/2**20)
print('peak child rss MiB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024)
assert all(s['status']=='forwarded' for s in out['streams'])
offs = 0
for s in out['streams']:
    assert s['offset'] == offs; offs += s['length']
print('OK')
PY
